senses.en_definition: Provisionally, the proper name Perry; the intended referent and lexical interpretation remain unconfirmed.
senses.ms_definition: Jika merujuk kepada seseorang, Perry ialah nama khas; maksud sebenar bentuk dalam paket ini belum dapat dipastikan.

etymology.historical_story: Names can travel into Malay texts without becoming ordinary Malay vocabulary. A library catalogue, subtitle, or conversation may preserve Perry simply because it identifies someone. The supplied packet gives no original passage or documented name history, so neither a particular person nor an etymological lineage can responsibly be assigned to this occurrence.
